source.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 中间版本开启内测
source.author: OSCHINA

title.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash内测：新架构与20并发限制
title.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: New Architecture, 20-Concurrency Test

excerpt.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash开启限时内测，采用原生多模态新架构并保持V4 Flash价格，但20并发限制显示其主要用于验证。
excerpt.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash enters a limited test with native multimodality and V4 Flash pricing, while a 20-concurrency cap signals an evaluation focus.

text.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash开启两天内测
text.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Opens a Two-Day Test

text.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash于9月8日下午开启中间版本内测，测试模型名直接包含“expires-on-0910”，意味着它将在9月10日自动下线。这不是正式发布，而是邀请开发者在短窗口内验证尚未定稿的版本。调用方式几乎不变：保留原有base_url，仅替换模型名称即可。
text.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash entered an intermediate-version test on the afternoon of September 8. Its model name includes “expires-on-0910,” indicating that access is scheduled to end on September 10. This is not a general release, but a short evaluation window for an unfinished version. Developers can keep the existing base_url and change only the model name.

text.zh: 新架构与原生多模态是核心变化
text.en: New Architecture and Native Multimodality

text.zh: 官方强调的重点不是一次普通的参数调整，而是新的模型结构。与V4 Flash通过独立Vision扩展处理视觉输入的方式不同，V4.1 Flash被描述为原生支持多模态，把图像与文本输入整合到模型本身。这个变化理论上有助于统一处理流程，但内测阶段仍需通过实际任务判断能力、稳定性和兼容性。
text.en: The central claim is not a routine parameter update but a new model structure. Unlike V4 Flash, which used a separate Vision extension for visual input, V4.1 Flash is described as natively multimodal, integrating image and text handling into the model itself. That could simplify the processing path, but real tasks are still needed to assess its capability, stability, and compatibility.

text.zh: 价格与V4 Flash保持一致，没有内测加价。空闲时段，缓存命中输入为每百万tokens 0.05元，未命中输入为1.5元，输出为4.5元；高峰时段对应为0.1元、3元和9元。已有开发者分享的测试中，输出速度最高达到507 tokens/s，生成SVG动画的案例为328 tokens/s，多人反馈平均速度超过300 tokens/s。这些是个别实测或社区反馈，不应视为统一保证。
text.en: Pricing remains the same as V4 Flash, with no beta surcharge. During off-peak periods, cached input costs 0.05 yuan per million tokens, uncached input costs 1.5 yuan, and output costs 4.5 yuan. Peak-period prices are 0.1, 3, and 9 yuan respectively. Developers have reported speeds as high as 507 tokens per second, while an SVG animation example reached 328 tokens per second; several users reported averages above 300. These figures come from individual tests or community feedback and are not a universal guarantee.

text.zh: 20并发限制决定了内测用途
text.en: The 20-Concurrency Cap Defines the Test’s Scope

text.zh: V4.1 Flash内测版每个账号最多20并发，而V4 Flash正式版为2500并发、V4 Pro为500并发。这个差距清楚表明，当前版本更适合功能验证、效果对比和反馈收集，不适合线上业务压测或大规模流量承载。开发者还需要关注首字时延、长任务稳定性、多模态准确度，以及不同Agent框架下的表现。
text.en: The test version allows up to 20 concurrent requests per account, compared with 2,500 for the V4 Flash release and 500 for V4 Pro. That gap strongly suggests a purpose centered on feature checks, comparative evaluation, and feedback rather than production load testing or large-scale traffic. Developers should also examine time to first token, long-task stability, multimodal accuracy, and behavior across agent frameworks.

text.zh: V4.1 Flash能否承接Pro业务
text.en: Can V4.1 Flash Take Over Pro Workloads?

text.zh: 这次内测的商业问题很明确：能否用接近Pro的能力，覆盖Flash的价格和速度。官方反馈问卷专门询问模型是否可以全面替代线上V4 Pro，并要求填写账号、Agent工具或框架及任务对比结果。若后续版本能够在复杂推理和原生多模态上达到足够水平，To-C应用与Agent产品可能获得更低成本的选择；但目前材料只证明了测试方向，尚不足以证明替代关系。
text.en: The commercial question is straightforward: can the model approach Pro-level capability while retaining Flash-level cost and speed? The official feedback form specifically asks whether it could fully replace V4 Pro in production and requests account details, agent tools or frameworks, and comparative task results. If later versions perform well enough on complex reasoning and native multimodality, consumer applications and agent products could gain a lower-cost option. The available material, however, establishes an evaluation goal rather than proof of replacement.

text.zh: 从7月底到8月底，DeepSeek连续推进V4 Flash、V4 Pro、Harness和Vision相关更新，V4.1 Flash可能是下一轮迭代的开端。现阶段最稳妥的判断是：它值得在截止日前用于短任务和多模态场景评测，但不应据此迁移生产流量。最终价值仍取决于正式版是否保留速度、价格与架构优势，并解除或提高并发限制。
text.en: DeepSeek made several V4-related moves from late July through August, including V4 Flash, V4 Pro, Harness, and Vision updates, so V4.1 Flash may mark the start of another iteration cycle. The cautious conclusion is that it is worth testing on short tasks and multimodal workflows before the deadline, but the evidence does not justify moving production traffic yet. Its lasting value will depend on whether a final release preserves the reported speed, pricing, and architectural advantages while removing or raising the concurrency limit.
